description: Deterministic smoke dataset for the search evaluation harness. The media ids are synthetic and refer to no real image, so this file can live in the repository and run in CI. It exists to prove the harness scores correctly end to end, and carries no claim about Find's retrieval quality.

queries.query: red bicycle leaning on a wall
queries.notes: Perfect case: both relevant ids rank first in the smoke run.
Text-heavy case: the single relevant id ranks third.
Partial case: one of two relevant ids is retrieved.
Deliberate miss: nothing relevant is retrieved, so this query must land in worst_cases and drag MRR down.

queries.query: query that returns nothing at all
queries.notes: Exercises the empty-result path: the retriever returns zero rows.
